concerns.text: FR‑004 requires a mixed‑effects model with Subject as a random effect (DSRT ~ Entropy + Age + Sex + MeanFD + (1|Subject)). The plan’s Phase 3 description states “Fit OLS per parcel (`DSRT ~ Entropy + Age + Sex + MeanFD`)”, which omits the random‑effect term, thus the functional requirement is not satisfied.
